title: Umnqobi Phakathi KweeHorizons Ezimbini
intro: Kwiingxelo zesikhokelo sikaThixo, umntu omnye uhlukile njengomlawuli onamandla kunye nomkhonzi othobekileyo ka-Allah. Lo mntu wahamba waya kwiindawo ezikude zomhlaba, ebona ilanga liphuma ebantwini abangaqhelekanga kwaye litshona entwasahlobo emnyama emnyama. Okumangalisayo kukuba, lo mkhonzi wayenikwe umsebenzi wokwakha umqobo ongaqhelekanga nxamnye nesizwe esinobubi obukhulu. Ngaba ungamfumana lo mntu udumileyo kwiQuran?
clues: Ndihambe ndaya kwindawo apho ilanga liphuma khona nalapho litshona khona
Ndayalelwa ukuba ndakhe umqobo omkhulu ndisebenzisa isinyithi
Ndivale isithuba esiphakathi kweentaba ezimbini ezinde ngentsimbi enyibilikisiweyo
Bendingeyongelosi okanye umprofeti, kodwa ndingumkhonzi othe uThixo wamnika inceba.

arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰذَا ٱلْقَرْنَيْنِ إِنَّ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ مُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَهَلْ نَجْعَلُ لَكَ خَرْجًا عَلَىٰٓ أَن تَجْعَلَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُمْ سَدًّۭا
verse: They said, "O Dhul-Qarnayn, indeed Gog and Magog are [great] corrupters in the land. So may we assign for you an expenditure that you might make between us and them a barrier?" (18:94)
